delta.instruction: Add search_accommodations(city, max_price_per_night=None, min_occupancy=None, max_min_nights=None). Query Accommodation entities where city == city, price <= max_price_per_night, 'maximum occupancy' >= min_occupancy (party size), and 'minimum nights' <= max_min_nights (length of stay). Return all Accommodation attributes (NAME, city, price, room type, minimum nights, maximum occupancy).

rho: Query idx=0 delivered a flight-only plan: cs_failed=['is_valid_restaurants','is_valid_accommodation','is_not_absent'] because lodging could not be searched (FUNCTIONS catalog is empty for non-flight services); idx=1-5 delivered nothing (delivery=17%). Every multi-day plan (all 6 queries) requires lodging, so this single gap blocks the most failed queries.

delta.instruction: Add search_restaurants(city, cuisine=None, max_avg_cost=None). Query Restaurant entities where City == city, optionally Cuisines contains cuisine (case-insensitive substring), and 'Average Cost' <= max_avg_cost. Return Name, City, Cuisines, Average Cost.

rho: idx=0 cs_failed includes is_valid_restaurants and is_not_absent — the plan contained no valid dining because no restaurant search existed; dining is a daily requirement for all 6 queries, and idx=1-5 non-delivery (delivery=17%) also traces to missing dining coverage.

delta.instruction: Add search_attractions(city). Query Attraction entities where City == city; return Name and City. Used to ground each day's itinerary and to justify which cities are visited.

rho: idx=0 CS_FAILED includes is_reasonable_visiting_city and is_not_absent — visited cities had no attraction evidence in the plan, since only search_flights was callable. Recurring pattern (city grounding) with zero coverage in the catalog; also contributes to idx=1-5 non-delivery.

It was invoked in idx=0 with only {"origin": "Fort Lauderdale"} (12 rows), leaving destination/date/price unconstrained.
